name: gitlab
description: Work on GitLab merge requests and pipelines of the current repository, picking the host and token from its git remote.

tokens.title: GitLab tokens
tokens.description: host=token pairs separated by commas, one per GitLab you use (gitlab.com=glpat-..., gitlab.example.com=glpat-...). Each token is sent only to its own host, picked from the repository's git remote. Needs the api scope; leave it out of repository settings, which would make the plugin refuse it.
